discussion.body:
User rewrite of the single-ending cinematic.
Still one ending, Act 13, no second fork. Old thesis kept underneath: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, world scarred and standing.
New last image: Cael accepts God of Death under the public name God of Life and is sad about it. Liraen takes Life. Together, separate, mirrored. Romance grade unchanged (suggestive, not explicit). Both leads live.
Predecessor God of Life = Vortan. Variations list is unchanged (Bengenia, graves, Velith/Vortan fate, Sigil texture, personal epilogues) except Vortan's fate now has to leave room for that office to pass.
